Order 
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 482 of Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking anticipatory bail in connection with FIR/Crime No.402/2022 dated 06.11.2022 registered at Police Station Lanji, District Balaghat for the offences punishable under Sections 420 and 406 of IPC and Sections 21(1), 21(2), 21(3) of Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant contends that the complainant approached the police with an allegation that he came to know from his neighbours that the present applicant and one Akshay Kumar, used to double the amount by investing the same in double money scheme.

Accordingly, the complainant then went to the house of the present applicant and handed over a sum of Rs.2,50,000/- and in lieu of the said amount, the present applicant gave a cheque which was signed by co-accused Akshay Kumar of Rs.5,00,000/- which was to be matured on 22.07.2022.

According to the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:12159 2 MCRC-11080-2025 complainant, he was instructed by the present applicant to submit the cheque for encashment after the date of maturity, however, after the date of maturity, when the cheque was submitted with the bank for encashment, the same got dishonored.

It is further contended by the counsel that a perusal of the statement of the complainant makes it abundantly clear that it is the complainant who came to the present applicant and there is no allegation of misguiding the complainant or there was no intention Rajkumar Billare vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43959027/
1 to dupe him.

sentences.text:
Thus, it is clear that the present applicant has been made a scapegoat and he is not the person who signed the cheque and the cheque in question was signed by co- accused Akshay Kumar,
therefore, he deserves to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.

3. Per contra, learned counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that the present applicant has committed the aforesaid offence and the information was sought from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI).

entities.text: Securities and Exchange Board of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It was informed to the Superintendent of Police Balaghat that neither the present applicant is registered with SEBI in any capacity nor there is any permission to the present applicant to collect funds from general public.
It is contended by the counsel that there was violation of the provisions of Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes.

Thus,
looking to the serious allegation against the present applicant, the present application deserves to be dismissed.

4. Heard the rival submissions and perused the case diary.
5.

A perusal of the case diary as well as statement of the complainant prima facie reflects that the complainant upon coming to know NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:12159 3 MCRC-11080-2025 about the alleged scheme, himself contacted the present applicant and as per his statement, on his own volition, went to the house of the present applicant.
The complaint so made by the complainant prima facie does not reveal that the present applicant has persuaded the complainant to part with the money with a false assurance to double the same.

6. Considering the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case and also the fact that prima facie there are no allegations of misleading or misguiding the complainant, this Court deems it appropriate to enlarge the applicant on anticipatory bail, therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that in the event of arrest, applicant- Rajkumar Billare shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer for his appearance before him during the course of investigation or before the trial Court concerned during trial, as the case may be.
8. It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by all the conditions as enumerated under Section 482(2) of BNSS.
